jobs.occupation: Executive Assistant - International FMCG Company - Brussels
jobs.description:
As Executive Assistant, you will serve as a trusted partner to senior leadership, ensuring the smooth coordination of day-to-day activities and helping drive operational efficiency. This is a highly visible position offering exposure to key stakeholders across the business in a fast-paced and international environment.
 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international FMCG company based in Brussels, known for its portfolio of well-established consumer brands and collaborative working environment. With a strong presence across international markets, the company combines innovation, operational excellence, and a people-focused culture.
 

Description

As an Executive Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Manage complex calendars, meetings and changing priorities to keep schedules clear and well organised.
• Coordinate appointments and prepare meeting arrangements to support efficient daily planning.
• Prepare presentations, reports, meeting agendas, and correspondence.
• Organise travel arrangements and itineraries, ensuring practical details are in place.
• Handle incoming communications and direct queries to the appropriate contacts.
• Prepare meeting materials and follow up on agreed actions to maintain progress.
• Handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
• Provide administrative support to facilitate effective decision-making.

• You have proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or Management Assistant.
• You are fluent in English and French or Dutch, any additional language is a plus.
• You possess strong organizational and time-management skills.
• You can anticipate needs, manage priorities, and work independently.
• You demonstrate a high level of discretion and professionalism.
• Excellent skills in MS Office.

jobs.occupation: Veterinary Sales Representative - Brussels & Waals Brabant
jobs.description:
Our client is a global organization active in animal health, supporting veterinary professionals through innovative products and solutions aimed at improving the well-being of companion animals.

• Promote animal health pharma products through face-to-face and virtual interactions with veterinarians

Our client is an international organization active in the energy sector.

Jobomschrijving

• SAP CO and allocation cycles: Maintain, execute, review and troubleshoot cost allocation cycles, including assessments and distributions across cost centres, activities, departments, products and other relevant dimensions.
• Management accounting: Support the design and consistent application of analytical accounting principles, cost-centre structures, cost-driver logic and allocation methodologies.
• Direct and indirect costs: Analyse cost flows, distinguish direct from indirect costs, validate allocation keys and ensure that costs are assigned consistently and transparently.
• Reporting and analysis: Develop and maintain management reports; analyse actual results against budget, forecast and prior periods; investigate and explain significant variances.
• Data quality and reconciliation: Consolidate, review and validate large volumes of financial and operational data; perform reconciliations between SAP, management reporting and accounting records.
• Excel-based modelling: Build and maintain efficient reporting tools and analyses using advanced formulas, PivotTables, lookups and structured datasets.
• Process improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate reporting and allocation processes while strengthening controls and documentation.
• Management support: Prepare clear financial analyses and ad hoc reports for management and support stakeholders in understanding cost drivers and allocation outcomes.

• Professional experience: Relevant hands-on experience in controlling, management accounting, cost accounting or financial reporting, preferably within a complex international organization.
• Analytical accounting: A sound understanding of management accounting and cost-allocation concepts, or demonstrable experience and readiness to quickly deepen expertise in these areas.
• Excel: Advanced command of Microsoft Excel, especially PivotTables, formulas, lookups, data validation and analysis of large datasets. This is an essential requirement.
• Power BI: Experience with Power BI is a plus and will be positively valued.
Analytical mindset: Ability to understand and challenge complex cost flows, allocation keys and reporting logic, with strong attention to detail and data consistency.

• Ways of working: Structured, accurate, autonomous and pragmatic, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Finance and operational functions.
• Industry background: Experience in a company with manufacturing or production operations is a strong advantage, particularly in an industrial, energy, chemical or petrochemical environment.
• Languages: Fluent English is required. French, Dutch or Italian would be an asset.

Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Between 5 to 15 stops/day
• Never on weekends or on holidays

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

jobs.occupation: Join Our Team as an Order Picker Warehouse Associate – Start Immediately in a Dynamic Environment!
jobs.description:
As an order picker warehouse associate, you play a key role in the warehouse operation. You will operate a high-level order picker truck (VNA), allowing you to safely pick products from elevated racks. Using a handheld scanner, you accurately check locations, quantities, and the correctness of orders. Your effort ensures that customers receive the right products on time and keeps the logistics process running smoothly.

On a typical workday, you collect customer orders by picking products from various warehouse locations. You work closely with colleagues, strictly follow safety instructions, and keep your workspace clean. You check products for damage or missing items and report these to the team leader. Packing and preparing orders for shipment is also part of your tasks, ensuring everything is ready to go out to customers efficiently.

Are you physically fit, detail-oriented, and do you enjoy a varied job in logistics? Apply today and make a difference in a close-knit team where collaboration and safety are essential.

• Previous experience as an order picker or warehouse associate is a plus.
• Certificate of good conduct (criminal record certificate) required.
• License or certificate for high-level order picker truck is an advantage.
• English speaking skills at level 3/5 (for effective communication and understanding instructions).
• Good physical fitness: able to stand, walk, and lift up to 17 kg.
• Accurate, responsible, and able to work safely in a fast-paced environment.

As an operator in a 3-shift system, you’re responsible for ensuring a smooth production process. You’ll work with modern installations and ensure animal proteins are processed correctly. Your technical skills and attention to detail are essential to guarantee the quality of our products.

On a typical workday, you start with a shift handover, then set up and check the machines. You closely monitor the production process, perform quality checks, and record data in the production software. You quickly identify and report malfunctions so the team can respond efficiently. Cleaning tasks and adhering to hygiene regulations are also part of your role. Working one Saturday out of three is not a problem for you.

Are you stress-resistant, eager to learn, and do you enjoy variety? Apply today and become part of a strong team in a forward-thinking sector!

• At least a higher secondary education diploma

• Experience as an operator (1 to >10 years) is a plus

• Confident with production and reporting software

• Good spoken English skills

• Able to perform quality checks and accurately document production data

• Able to quickly identify and report malfunctions

• Stress-resistant, eager to learn, and solution-oriented

• Enjoy working in a team and show responsibility

• Willing to work in a 3-shift system, including 1 out of 3 Saturdays
